_meta.purpose: Tool registry — the API an agent reads to discover every capability without reading source. Each tool is a deterministic CLI: JSON in (args/stdin), JSON out (stdout).
_meta.convention: All paths relative to repo root. Tools are pipe-friendly and side-effect-free unless they name an output file.

tools.does: Validate state files against their JSON Schema contracts.
tools.when: Before appending to any state file; inside build.py.

tools.does: Compute every KPI for a week, with value + green/amber/red status. The only place operating math happens.
tools.when: Weekly review; monthly gate; any time you need the numbers. Never compute KPIs by hand.

tools.does: Evaluate a decision policy (first matching rule wins) and optionally log an auditable decision. --log is week-anchored (date = Monday of --week, not wall-clock) and idempotent per (week, policy, subject): re-logging the same week is a no-op, so the decisions.jsonl logbook is reproducible.
tools.when: Any go/no-go, keep/fix/cut, buy/hold, or threshold decision. brief.py emits ready-to-run --week --log commands.

tools.does: Plan a clustered restock route over machines below the fill trigger.
Build a per-SKU purchase order: refills each machine's planogram toward par (scaled by current_fill), costed against the catalog, with true blended margin.
tools.when: Weekly supplier reorder, before a restock run.

tools.does: Validate and append one weekly scorecard entry (raw inputs only).
tools.when: Start of the weekly review, to close the prior week.

tools.does: Project the latest KPI truth into THREE deterministic views: state.json (machine, lossless), brief.agent.json (ghost: each flag's acts_via action + runnable/proposes/manual partition + ready-to-run command), brief.operator.md (pilot: the one number, ranked flags, the next action per flag). No LLM; the action is a join over kpis.yaml#acts_via. Run twice -> byte-identical.
tools.when: End of the weekly review, to brief the three readers. The ghost reads brief.agent.json to pick its next action; the pilot reads brief.operator.md.

tools.does: Orchestrator: validate all state -> compute latest KPIs -> regenerate workbook + HTML manual.
tools.when: After any change to config or state.

tools.does: Reproducible 'week in the life' — drives the whole weekly loop through the real tools against a sandbox copy of state (never mutates committed data).
tools.when: Demoing or smoke-testing the end-to-end loop.
